vocabulary_focus.concept: To backup data / To save information

expressions.en: To backup data / To save information
expressions.cn: 备份数据 / 保存信息 (bèifèn shùjù / bǎocún xìnxī)

work.scenario: Your company is implementing a new HR system and needs everyone to update their profiles and understand the digital transformation process.
key_phrases: Pihak pengurusan akan melancarkan platform HR dalam talian yang baharu.
Sila kemaskini profil anda di sistem tersebut.
Ini adalah sebahagian daripada transformasi digital syarikat.

life.scenario: Your smartphone is acting up, and you need to update its software and back up your important photos before attempting a factory reset.
key_phrases: Saya kena backup data penting dulu.
Kalau tak okay, mungkin kena repair.

tech.scenario: As a developer, you are preparing to launch a new software version, which involves upgrading the existing system and troubleshooting any last-minute bugs.
key_phrases: Kita perlu menaik taraf sistem sedia ada sebelum pelancaran.
Ada beberapa isu yang perlu diselesaikan segera.
Kami akan melancarkan versi baharu minggu depan.
